_comment: Census SPM poverty-rate backtests: the microcosm baseline's weighted share of persons in SPM poverty (in_poverty; child rows restrict to is_child), sliced by state, vs Census P60-287 published rates. State rows use the 2022-2024 three-year averages (CPS state single-year samples are too noisy); the two US rows use single-year 2024. Out-of-sample: poverty appears nowhere in the calibration target surface — person and child counts per state ARE calibrated, pinning the denominators but not the rates. Caveats: the simulation period is 2024 against a 2022-2024 average benchmark, and small-state 3-year averages still carry wide CPS margins of error, so treat single-state gaps of a couple of points as noise; the systematic pattern across states is the signal.
